text:
elaine: Release window open — starting canary->prod for v1.4.8 at 22:00 UTC. Changes: KV cache prefill tuning, batching adjustments. Please run the quick verification checklist below. Deploy-bot will start canary in ~2m.

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout to 2 hosts in us-west. Running health checks + quick synthetic suite (quick-llm-query, kv-prefill-test). Logs: https://ci.internal/release/1755512345/logs

ben: ack. I'll watch p95 and error-rate dashboards.

deploy-bot: quick-llm-query passed on canary (p95 62ms). kv-prefill-test shows ~6% higher miss rate vs baseline — digging in.

ash: that's expected for the first warmup window. Are misses concentrated in initial traffic or steady-state?

deploy-bot: misses concentrated in first 30s after container start, steady-state aligns with baseline.

samir: I'm seeing a short p99 spike in traces correlated with prefill TTL bump, small sample.

maria: is that rollback-worthy?

elaine: not yet. Let canary run another 5m. Rollback threshold: miss rate >10% OR error-rate >0.5%.

ben: creating a dashboard snapshot and saving to /releases/1755512345/snap.png

ash: quick question — are we keeping EU pinned to v1.4.7?

elaine: yes, EU remains pinned until regional sanity checks complete. Only us-west moves forward for now.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 5 hosts, running synthetic burst (100 concurrent short prompts).

deploy-bot: synthetic burst results: 0.2% 5xx during ramp, p95 increased to 85ms during ramp but recovered to ~65ms after warmup.

samir: 5xxs are 503 gateway timeouts from edge proxies, looks transient and not from model containers.

maria: recommend adding a 30s ramp and re-run before global push.

elaine: agree. Pausing global rollout. Adding note to release notes: 'rolling: paused for extended warmup due to transient proxy errors'.

ben: noted — pinning v1.4.7 in EU and updating changelog state.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused, no rollback initiated. Next steps: re-run burst test with 30s ramp in 10m, notify #eng-sre.

ash: if we hit another spike, please capture heapdumps/flamegraphs — I'll attach a lightweight tracing hook.

samir: adding trace hooks now — traces at /ops/traces/1755512345

elaine: thanks. I'll update the release ticket and add a short blurb in the release notes about the paused global push. Contact me if you want to force a rollback.

maria: :thumbsup: ping me before unpause.

ben: saved snapshot + logs, tagging @oncall for visibility :bell:

deploy-bot: Summary: functional checks OK on canary; transient proxy 503s + brief latency during synthetic burst; rollout paused; EU pinned to v1.4.7.
